author: ThioJoe
description:
Some dummy thought it would be a good idea to set up a fake plane WiFi hotspot

It's being reported that on a flight back from DEFCON 34, a cybersecurity conference known for its shenanigans, someone set up a fake Delta Wi-Fi hotspot. Not many details are known about the intent and motivation, but obviously it was not an accident. But there's a lot of conflicting reports about what exactly went down, so I did some digging and found out the whole story.
